notes.title: Free update for Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy on November 19!
notes.content:
Take that! Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy is getting a free update on November 19!
Court will be back in session with quality of life updates including Episode Selection, Story Mode, as well as three additional features to enjoy in Gallery mode!
